link.description: Stripe Checkout URL to redirect the browser to. Present when no `payment_method_id` was supplied.

message.description: Human-readable message to show while redirecting.

link.description: URL to redirect the browser to. Single-use and short-lived.

cluster.description: The created cluster. Present when an existing payment method was charged successfully.

name.description: Cluster name, unique across Phase Two.

host.description: Base URL of the cluster's Keycloak instance.

region.description: Region the cluster is provisioned in.

name.description: Region identifier, usable as the `region` argument when creating a cluster.

domain.description: Custom domain recorded at provision time, when one was given. This is not the live hostname — use `cluster.host.update` to change which domain the cluster serves.

status.description: Lifecycle state. A cluster is only usable in `ACTIVE`; `PENDING_DELETION` and `ARCHIVED` are terminal.

allOf.description: Lifecycle state of a dedicated cluster.
allOf.title: ClusterState

owner.description: ID of the organization that owns the cluster.

variant.description: `DEDICATED` when the cluster has an owning organization, `SHARED` otherwise.

tier.description: Subscription tier, which determines the cluster's resource limits.

resource_limits.description: `STANDARD`, or `CUSTOM` when the cluster has been exempted from tier count limits.

created_at.description: When the cluster was created, as epoch milliseconds.

requires_action.description: True when the payment method needs additional authentication (3DS/SCA) before the cluster can provision. Complete `client_secret` inline with Stripe.js.

client_secret.description: Stripe PaymentIntent client secret to confirm inline. Present only when `requires_action` is true.

cluster_id.description: ID of the already-created cluster awaiting payment confirmation. Present only when `requires_action` is true.
